Charming colorful cartoon shapes, clear expressive robot, cozy simple setting, steady medium-wide camera shot. The robot tilts the watering can and a gentle stream waters the soil in the pot throughout the scene. At the top of the frame throughout the entire video, display the exact title 'Small steps' in large clean readable lettering, centered with comfortable margins.
